findings.title: Negative (and absurdly negative) litres are accepted by the form and the API
findings.where: Beds page 'Record past watering' form; POST /api/waterings
findings.steps: On /beds click 'Record past watering' for North bed, enter -3 in Litres, Save. Or POST /api/waterings {"bed_id":1,"watered_on":"2026-11-01","litres":-1e308}.
findings.expected: Litres must be greater than zero; client and server refuse negatives with a visible reason / 422.
findings.actual: Form shows success 'Recorded -3 L on 12 Nov 2026.'; API returns 201 for -5 and -1e308. Client check only rejects exactly 0, schema only has le=10000 (no gt=0).
findings.evidence: Waterings list shows '-3 L', '-5 L' and '-100,000,000,...,000 L' rows; totals become negative so the '... in total' text disappears.

findings.title: Tiny positive litres shown as '0 L'
findings.steps: POST litres 1e-9 (or type 0.000001 in the form).
findings.expected: Reject amounts below a sensible minimum or display them accurately.
findings.evidence: Waterings table row '12 Nov 2026, 13:32 North bed 0 L'.

findings.title: Huge stored litres value breaks 375px layout
findings.steps: Record a watering with litres -1e308 (accepted, see above), open /waterings at 375px width.
findings.actual: Page scrollWidth 3466px at a 375px viewport due to the unwrapped number.

findings.title: Waterings page and dashboard watering error states have no retry
findings.steps: Make GET /api/waterings return 500, navigate to Waterings via the nav link.
findings.expected: Error message with a Retry button that refetches without reload.
findings.actual: Only 'Could not load waterings.' with no button; dashboard section likewise shows only an alert (refresh is not even destructured).
findings.evidence: main contains no buttons in the error state.

findings.title: 'Water now' spins forever when the request hangs (no timeout)
findings.where: /beds Water now, also Save watering and delete watering
findings.steps: Make POST /api/waterings never respond, click 'Water now' on a bed, wait 12s+.
findings.expected: Request times out after 10 s and shows an error; button re-enabled.
findings.actual: Button stays 'Watering…' and disabled indefinitely; the API client has no timeout.
findings.evidence: After 12 s bed card still shows 'Watering…'.

findings.title: Dates far in the past accepted (year 0001)
findings.actual: 201; shown as '1 Jan 1' at the bottom of the list.
findings.evidence: Waterings row '1 Jan 1 North bed 2 L'.

findings.title: Retried/double save after a timeout creates duplicate waterings
findings.steps: Submit 'Water now' or 'Save watering'; if the response is lost/slow and the user clicks again after the request ends or reloads, a second row is created.
findings.expected: One change per user action (idempotency key or dedupe).
findings.actual: No idempotency; every POST inserts a new row.

findings.title: Bed filter silently empty when beds fail to load
findings.expected: Error shown for the bed filter.
findings.actual: bedsResult error is ignored; dropdown only shows 'All beds' with no message.
findings.evidence: Code: const { data: beds } = bedsResult, no error handling.

findings.title: Today's date can be refused as 'in the future' across time zones
findings.steps: Browser in a time zone ahead of the server; keep default date (browser's today) and save.
findings.actual: Server compares with its own date.today() and returns 'Watering date cannot be in the future.'
findings.evidence: Code: todayIso uses browser local date, not_in_future uses server local date.
